claim_boundary: Post hoc descriptive aggregation of the frozen tokenizer-only census. This artifact performs no model forward, activation capture, intervention, behavioral or semantic test, confirmation, causal localization, control freeze, or Phase I gate decision.
interpretation_limits: The seven output classes are exact equivalence only on the fixed 115 items and four contexts.
Token IDs are compared only within a tokenizer output class, never across vocabularies.
Equal token count or prefix structure does not establish semantic equivalence.
The focal-target summary is post hoc control-design evidence and is not a new frozen control set.
No activation, behavior, mechanism, causality, or cross-model scientific result follows from this aggregation.
